description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class 'ConnectionIdNotExplicitlySettableException' in the Eclipse Ditto project. The class extends DittoRuntimeException and implements ConnectivityException, representing an error when a connection ID is set explicitly, which is not allowed. It includes builder methods, static factory methods to create instances from messages or JSON, and annotations indicating immutability and thread safety status.

classes.name: ConnectionIdNotExplicitlySettableException
classes.description: This class represents an exception thrown when a connection ID is set explicitly in a context where it should not be, i.e., when creating or managing connectivity in Eclipse Ditto. It includes static methods for creating instances from messages or JSON objects, and a nested Builder class for constructing instances with a fluent API.
